dedupe_keys.name: western australia abandoned mines demirs abandoned mine sites dataset

description: A spatial dataset of abandoned mine sites in Western Australia. The data.wa.gov.au page says the dataset records historic abandoned mine features and sites, has been released each year since December 2002, covers about 76 per cent of the state's high-priority historic mining sites and includes photographs of many features. It is free under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence and downloadable as file geodatabase, shapefile and MapInfo TAB through the DASC data portal, with metadata last modified on 4 November 2025. Coverage is Western Australia, with the goldfields and other historic mining districts. Caveats: coverage is partial, as the page says, and the attributes are not listed on the page read. For simulation it locates open shafts and other legacy mine hazards near roads, rail, pipelines and towns for exposure and safety studies. A related catalogue record is the OSMRE e-AMLIS inventory of abandoned coal mine land problems in the United States.
